The '''Concussion Cylinder''' was a component used on [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]. It was the main body of the [[Missile/Legends|projectile]] between the [[Power cell/Legends|energy pack]] and the [[Propellant Chamber]]. The missile's [[energy envelope projector]]s were mounted on the cylinder.<ref name="EGWT" />
